slides.title: Thursday Sports Schedule
slides.body: Golf, MLB, WNBA, and NHL all on deck. Follow @any_and_all_sports for daily schedule updates.

slides.title: Golf Starts at Midnight
slides.body: PGA Tour, LPGA, LIV Golf, and DP World Tour all begin at 12:00 AM ET across ESPN+, CBS, NBC, USA, Peacock, FS1, FS2, and Golf Channel.

slides.title: MLB Day Slate
slides.body: Padres-Phillies, Orioles-Red Sox, Guardians-Yankees, Giants-Brewers, and more. Watch on MLB.TV plus local and national channels.

slides.title: Primetime Games
slides.body: Dream-Fever at 7:00 PM ET on Prime. Golden Knights-Hurricanes at 8:00 PM ET on ABC. Valkyries-Lynx at 9:00 PM ET on Prime.

slides.title: Late MLB Matchups
slides.body: Blue Jays-Braves, Royals-Twins, A's-Cubs, Pirates-Astros, and Dodgers-D-backs close the night. Check MLB.TV and local network listings.
